text:
Olivia: morning all — quick async standup from the release lane, leaving at 5pm PT so dropping notes early
Srinivas: thanks, Olivia. TL;DR: where are we on the cut window and cherry-picks?
Olivia: cut window still open until 17:00 PT. main blockers: one flaky e2e in staging (integration/test-runner), and a backport conflict for the autoscaler config on dedicated pools
Jake: I left a patch for the autoscaler backport (PR #7281). needs a quick review — two-line change in config.yaml, but it touches the rolling policy logic. @Laura can you peek?
Laura: on it, will try to review before lunch. if it looks safe I'll merge and trigger a canary.
Olivia: thanks — if merged we can promote to canary and it should remove the surge we saw when a node went OOM last night
Srinivas: regarding the flaky e2e: logs show a timing assertion in the job-scheduler. I've reproduced locally with a slower GPU node. Hypothesis: KV cache warmup timing is different in the smaller test instances
Jake: reproducer command I used: `ENV=staging ./scripts/run-e2e --seed 42 --node-type=g4dn.xlarge` — added pastebin for full trace: https://paste.redwood.dev/abc123
Laura: thanks — if warmup is timing-related maybe add a small wait or use a health-check loop rather than strict timing. we should avoid masking real perf regressions though
Olivia: agreed. for the immediate cut I'm ok with a short wait + note in the test to follow up with a proper fix. we don't want the release to stall for a nondeterministic flake
ops-bot: deploy-check: canary pipeline for release/2026-03-17 started at 2319004705 — status: running
Srinivas: ops-bot, can you also flag if any autoscaler alerts fire during the canary window?
ops-bot: alert-hook registered: #eng-oncall, will post if cpu/gpu autoscaler anomalies detected
Jake: small FYI — there are 3 outstanding cherry-picks: two low-risk (metrics tags, logging) and one that touches the batching layer (queued as 7283). I'm marking 7283 as HOLD unless the canary is green
Olivia: good call. owners: @Jake will handle metrics/logging picks; @Srinivas will own the batching change if we decide to include it
Laura: review done for 7281, left one nit about a comment. nothing functional. approve after nit fixed.
Jake: fixed nit and pushed. merging now.
ops-bot: canary pipeline status: 2319004800 — smoke tests passed, rolling canary to 10% traffic
Olivia: excellent. I'll monitor logs and the release dashboard for the next 30m. if anything spikes we roll back and open an incident
Srinivas: I'll keep an eye on the scheduler traces and the e2e job queue. ping me if you see increased requeues
Laura: I'll sweep merge-queue for any other small backports and ping authors for quick approvals
Olivia: blockers summary: e2e flake (mitigated with temporary wait), autoscaler backport (merged), batching cherry 7283 on hold. plan: promote canary -> full in 40m if stable. I'll update this thread after the full promote
Jake: thanks, team. :thumbsup:
Olivia: leaving now — if anything urgent DM me, otherwise update thread.
ops-bot: deploy-check: full promotion started at 2319004950 — status: queued
Olivia: updating last note — promote queued, last watchpoint at 2319004980.
